name: dh-skills
description: Unity skills for Claude Code and Codex: a core plugin for every role, a uGUI plugin and a VFX plugin. Works with or without an Editor MCP bridge.

plugins.name: unity-core
plugins.description: Unity skills for every role on a Unity project: C# standard, recompile and play-mode verification, package docs, git release, analytics events, data sheets, plan handoff. Injects a skill index into sessions inside a Unity project.

plugins.name: unity-ui
plugins.description: uGUI workflow for Unity: panel lifecycle and layout rules, building a panel prefab from a mockup image, and brainstorming UI effects as an HTML preview.

plugins.name: unity-vfx
plugins.description: Real-time VFX for Unity, mobile-first: a shared core (brief, mesh-first, FSE overdraw budgets, uber material, audit and measurement scripts) plus combat, UI, environment and clothing skills.
